subtitle: Lesson 24 · Capstone: Diagnose & Fix a Realistic Performance Problem

eyebrow: Cause one -- confirmed with a query plan
code:
u_checklist_item WHERE u_store_region='WEST'
Before: full table scan -- 2.1M rows scanned
After:  index seek -- ~340 rows scanned
No index exists on u_store_region today
caption: A full table scan that was invisible at 50 stores is 6,000x the work at 500.
A query-in-a-loop: one round trip to u_store_config for every item in the batch.
Same result, one query total instead of one query per item in the batch.

eyebrow: Cause three -- semaphore pool at 7:00 AM
code:
Nightly Rollup job + Morning Reminder job
both claim the SAME semaphore set
+ 500 stores submitting at once
50 stores: no contention. 500: everything queues.
caption: The exact 40-minute, instance-wide slowdown this pattern produces.
